text:
SRE-bot: :rotating_light: Throughput alert: cluster g3-prod-x observing 30-40% throughput drop across realtime model pool. Investigating. (alert id: alert-8721)

alice: saw the alert, checking dashboards. latency p95 up a bit but the big drop is worker restarts.

ben: logs show repeated OOMs on CUDA device 0 on node g3-12, kernel fallback to cpu leading to thundering restarts.

dima: grabbing recent dmesg + runtime logs. suspicious slab allocator errors and rapid KV cache evictions.

carol: can you paste the OOM trace?

dima: here: ```
[ 1234.567890] Out of memory: GPU memory: Cannot allocate 4.2G
[ 1234.568012] gpu_driver: slab_corruption detected: inode=0x1a2b
[ 1234.569012] Worker 3421 killed, restarting
``` 

alice: that slab_corruption msg matches last week's patch regression (kernel-selection change). cc @dima

ben: runtime profile shows frequent kernel switches around large attention windows — leads to fragmented device allocations and slab collapse.

eva: quick mitigation: draining affected nodes and forcing kernel pinning to stable-ampere on current tasks.

dima: attempting a hotfix: set ENV `REDWOOD_KERNEL_POLICY=pin:stable-ampere` for pool realtime-a

SRE-bot: deploy started by dima at 1856034550

ben: after pinning, worker restarts dropped but throughput still ~10% below normal. KV cache hit rate has tanked — evictions spiking.

dima: eviction log snippet: ```json
{"pool":"realtime-a","kv_evictions":1245,"minute":"2026-03-18T14:29:00Z"}
```

carol: sounds like memory shear: small allocations from pinned kernels aren't reusable -> fragmentation -> OOM cascade.

alice: for now scaling up reserved capacity (add 2 GPUs) to absorb tail. also flagging for postmortem.

eva: starting job to run microbench of kernel selection heuristics with synthetic long seqs (seq=4096) to reproduce.

ben: created a quick perf trace link: https://perf.redwood/inv/1856034550 — shows rapid allocator churn at 90-120s intervals.

dima: rolling restart completed at 1856034620, scaling up + pinning mitigations applied.

SRE-bot: incident resolved (partial) — throughput recovered to ~98% at 1856034670. Postmortem pending.

alice: next steps: revert recent kernel heuristic commit, add regression test that simulates KV-caching under kernel switch, and increase alarm sensitivity for slab errors.

carol: logging follow-ups in #postmortems and assigning owners: dima (investigation), ben (perf tests), eva (repro harness).

ben: FYI I saw similar pattern in staging two days ago but dismissed as noisy tenant. will add alert correlation.

alice: good catch. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
